outcome: proportion of EMC care delivered by EMC trained midwives
cohort: The study included 4321 patient care episodes captured in the Maternal Enhanced and Critical Care (MEaCC) database from 13 acute NHS trusts in the Yorkshire and Humber region.
finding: 9% of women required enhanced maternal care or critical care, with most managed in maternity units, and women of Black ethnicity were more likely to require EMC or ICU.
cross-section timing: Data collected retrospectively over the period January 2021 to October 2024
